title: Our Legacy — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: Our legacy is reflected in the achievements of our graduates, the dedication of our faculty, and the confidence placed in us by students, parents, and industry partners.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

blocks.heading: Trusted Name in Higher Education
paras: For years, WhiteHouse has been recognized as a trusted name in higher education, dedicated to nurturing generations of students through quality teaching, innovation, and academic excellence. Our legacy is built on the achievements of our graduates, the dedication of our faculty, and the confidence placed in us by students, parents, and industry partners.

blocks.heading: Building on Solid Foundations
paras: Our commitment to academic excellence, student success, and community impact has shaped our identity and guided our growth.

groups.title: Foundation Established
text: WhiteHouse Education Foundation begins its mission to expand quality higher education in Eastern Nepal.

groups.title: WCBT Jhapa Campus Opens
text: The first campus launches with a focus on technology and business education, serving the Jhapa region.

groups.title: KU Partnership Formalized
text: Kathmandu University affiliation brings recognized BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs to our campus.

groups.title: Regional Impact Recognition
text: WCBT becomes recognized as a trusted institution contributing to Eastern Nepal's educational and technological advancement.

groups.title: Expanding Excellence
text: New research labs, expanded facilities, and growing industry partnerships strengthen our academic ecosystem.

groups.title: Academic Excellence
text: Rigorous standards, innovative teaching, and continuous improvement in all we do.

groups.title: Student-Centered Approach
text: Every decision prioritizes student success, growth, and career readiness.

groups.title: Community Impact
text: Creating positive change through education, research, and community engagement.

blocks.heading: Be Part of Our Growing Legacy
paras: Join thousands of students who have chosen WCBT for their academic and professional journey.
